primitive.relation: Relations: definitional equality with GTBase.common.del_es_rel. SGraph wrappers: same vertex type and convertible adjacency, related by the identity isomorphism. X191's fg_mk_sgraph form: extensional equality (the symmetric closure of an already symmetric, irreflexive relation), again related by the identity isomorphism.

retained_proof_lemmas.note: The six *_delete_edges_sym / *_delete_edges_irrefl lemmas of X7, chromatic XE1 and extremal XE1 keep their names and statements (equal up to conversion) and are re-proved from del_es_sym / del_es_irrefl. They are frozen verbatim as the opaque proof dependencies of each Legacy graph, and their normalized names are not claimed by this entry.

known_consumer_issues.Extremal.conjectures.XE1.xe1_triangle_fr: Dead and buggy (meta/STATEMENT_IMPROVEMENTS.md:1891): it deletes set0 instead of adding completion edges, and no statement uses it. Its meaning is unchanged by the alias redirect; not repaired here.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory 0.9.7 has no edge-family deletion. sgraph.del_edges A deletes the edges inside a vertex set A, a different operation, which agrees with single-edge deletion only when #|e| <= 2. Upstream also provides eq_diso and iso_connected, but leaves coloring.diso_chi unproved; GTBase.common.chi_diso proves the chromatic-number invariance from chi_isubgraph. GTBase.common.del_edge_set, already used by X214, X223 and X229, is the canonical with an unchanged body.
